why.title: Why ViaVitae
why.lead: Purpose-built software for the church vertical, engineered for EU compliance.
body: ViaVitae builds digital infrastructure specifically for churches, dioceses, deaneries and related organisations. Every product is designed around the way these communities actually work — from parish communication to cemetery services and donations.

We are an EU-focused vendor: infrastructure is hosted in the European Union, analytics are self-hosted, and the platform is built for GDPR compliance and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. This is a launch-gated summary; detailed references and case studies will be published once approved.

about.title: About ViaVitae
about.lead: Who we are and what we build.
body: ViaVitae is a software vendor serving the church vertical across the European Union. Our catalogue spans websites, donations, online stores, CRM and cemetery services.
Registered entity details, team information and company history are a launch gate and will be published here once verified by the ViaVitae legal entity.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.lead: Help faith communities serve people well, with trustworthy technology.
body: Our mission is to give churches and dioceses dependable, accessible and compliant digital tools, so they can focus on their communities rather than on technology.
This mission statement is a launch-gated placeholder and will be finalised and approved by ViaVitae before go-live.

partners.title: Partners
body: We work with hosting, payments and integration partners to deliver the ViaVitae platform across the EU.
The published partner list is a launch gate; named partners and logos will appear here once agreements and brand approvals are in place.

solutions.title: Solutions
solutions.lead: Tailored bundles for parishes, dioceses, cemeteries and stores.
body: ViaVitae solutions combine products from the catalogue into bundles for common needs: a parish presence, a diocese-wide platform, cemetery and funeral services, or online giving and stores.
Detailed solution bundles, eligibility and pricing are confirmed through the assessment and quote process.

legalCompliance.title: Legal & compliance
legalCompliance.lead: How ViaVitae approaches GDPR, accessibility and data residency.
body: ViaVitae is built for EU compliance: data is hosted in the European Union, analytics are self-hosted and consent-gated, and the assessment funnel follows a documented DPIA (DPIA-001).
Accessibility targets WCAG 2.2 AA. Security vulnerabilities follow the disclosure process and 72-hour breach SLA in SECURITY.md.

onboarding.title: Onboarding & training
onboarding.lead: Get your team confident with ViaVitae.
body: Onboarding covers content setup, language configuration, donations and cemetery modules, and administrator training.
Training materials and scheduled sessions are a launch-gate deliverable and will be listed here once published.
